description.value: Chali-Rosso Art Gallery is a fine art gallery operating since 2005, specializing in original works on paper by Modern Masters including Picasso, Dalí, Chagall, Miró, and Matisse, alongside Inuit art and contemporary Canadian artists. The gallery also holds a notable collection of limited-edition Salvador Dalí sculptures created via the lost-wax process. Situated at Canada Place on Vancouver's waterfront, it offers worldwide shipping and services including art appraisal and consignment.
